attackers_goals: Attackers may leverage Microsoft Teams to conduct phishing attacks by exploiting trusted communication channels with users inside the organization.
description: An external tenant is possibly attempting a phishing attack via Microsoft Teams.
investigative_actions: Verify the suspicious sign-in activity to validate the legitimacy of the suspicious login. Review Teams chat logs and meeting invites for interactions with external tenants, focusing on unusual file sharing or unsolicited links. Hunt for known phishing indicators (suspicious domains, URL patterns, or IPs) in the Teams messages and linked content. Evaluate the external tenant reputation. Check for anomalous MS Teams actions like suspicious application installation, message extraction, policy changes or internal spear phishing attempts linked to the user post-login. Follow further actions done by the account.
name: Possible phishing attack via Microsoft Teams
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
